purpose: Google Play feature graphics; illustrative artwork, not screenshots

exports.processing: Aspect-preserving centered crop and high-quality downsample from generated originals

prompts.en:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Google Play feature graphic for Lion Dance Kit. Generate a finished wide banner, exactly 1024 x 500 pixels (2.048:1).
Primary request: Beautiful polished promotional artwork for a mobile lion dance percussion practice app, in its established rich dark burgundy and warm gold palette.
Scene: subtle burgundy silk/paper texture with exceptionally restrained gold flowing rhythm arcs; clean, spacious editorial design, not a busy festival poster.
Subject: on the right half, a physically coherent Chinese southern lion dance barrel drum with red lacquer body, tan hide head, gold studs and two wooden sticks, accompanied by a pair of bronze Chinese cymbals with red fabric handles and a bronze gong. Elegant high-quality illustrated product still life with warm dimensional lighting. No lions, dragons, people, screens or phone frames.
Composition: wide, keep all important content comfortably within 8 percent margins. Left half is generous clear burgundy negative space for legible text. Instruments occupy right half, drum dominant, cymbals and gong secondary, no clipping of key subjects.
Text verbatim, left aligned, large clean cream/gold modern typography:
"Lion Dance Kit"
"Drum. Cymbals. Gong."
"Practice your rhythm."
Title most prominent, second and third lines smaller and clear. Natural capitalization exactly as supplied. No other text, no watermark, no app/store badges, no claims about ranking, price or downloads. This is illustrative promotional art, not an app screenshot.
Output opaque, full bleed, square corners.
prompts.zh:
Use case: text-localization. Edit the referenced promotional banner. Preserve the burgundy and gold artwork, instruments, lighting, texture and overall layout. Replace only the three English text lines with Simplified Chinese, using clear beautiful correctly rendered Chinese typography, same gold/cream color, left aligned. Exact text:
"舞狮乐器"
"鼓 · 钹 · 锣"
"随时练习节奏"
Title largest, instrument line and tagline smaller. Keep at least 8% left margin and comfortably readable text with right edge clear of the drum. No additional text. Output wide feature graphic 1024 x 500 pixels, opaque full bleed.
prompts.vi:
Use case: text-localization. Edit the referenced English promotional banner. Preserve the burgundy and gold artwork, instruments, lighting, texture and overall layout. Replace only the three text lines with this exact text, retaining all Vietnamese diacritics:
"Lion Dance Kit"
"Trống · Chũm chọe · Cồng"
"Luyện nhịp mỗi ngày"
Use clear modern cream/gold typography. Title largest, other lines smaller and readable. Left aligned, with 8 percent margin from left and right edges of lettering comfortably clear of drum. No additional text. Output wide feature graphic 1024 x 500 pixels, opaque full bleed.
